repo_notes.content: Personal utility-script collection. Two main tools: a CloneCD batch converter (Ruby, parallel, uses bchunk) and a website scraper generating RSS XML.

CloneCD/clonecd_batch_help.rb converts MODE1/2352 and MODE2/2352 disc images (.ccd/.img/.cue sets) to proper ISO files, scanning current dir + subdirs with parallel processing; depends on bchunk (brew).
erc_scraper/ scrapes course content from the ERC site to produce an RSS feed XML; run_erc_scraper.sh also uploads the result to a server.
See README.md plus the per-tool README files (CloneCD/README.clonecd_batch_help.md, erc_scraper/README.ercScraper.md) for usage.
